Docs/Data & replay

Data & replay

Download a stage dataset, inspect its schema, and verify frame restoration and open-loop action replay separately.

What is released

The Sharpa demonstrations were teleoperated in simulation, reviewed, exported as LeRobot v3.0 datasets with integrity certificates, and selected by successful action replay. The public pipeline starts at review/export in data_gen/recordings; the headset/glove teleoperation stack itself is not released.

Hub pathContentsApproximate size
data/sharpa/<env id>/100 replay-successful episodes per stage, with multi-view videos30 datasets · 10 GB total
data_append/sharpa/<env id>/Remaining reviewed state-only episodes where available; together with data/ they partition accepted recordings2.45 GB total
assets/task_object_meshes/Task object meshes0.11 GB
ckpt/Baseline checkpoints and release metadataSee checkpoint table

Get access to SIPAIR/DexArena ↗, then download one dataset from the code repository root:

hf download SIPAIR/DexArena --repo-type dataset --include "data/sharpa/CabinetPouringOpenCabinet-Sharpa-v1/**" --local-dir .

The maintainers' OpenCabinet validation snapshot contains 100 episodes and 13,121 control steps, about 176 MB. Their download time was approximately 90 seconds on one workstation; network and storage conditions vary.

Dataset layout and policy fields

data/sharpa/<env id>/
├── data/chunk-000/*.parquet             # one row per 20 Hz control step
├── videos/observation.images.<camera>/  # base and active-arm wrist cameras
├── meta/info.json, stats.json, tasks.parquet, episodes/
├── meta/recording_integrity.json        # source fingerprint, trim and file hashes
├── meta/subset_manifest.json           # release-subset selection
├── meta/video_manifest.json            # render counts and image checks
└── replay/source_<hash>/               # raw states, actions, infos and reset seed
ColumnMeaning
observation.stateRobot joint positions/velocities and task quantities. Width and layout depend on the task.
actionAbsolute joint-position targets: 29 for one Sharpa arm and hand, or 58 for both.
next.reward1 while the physical success condition holds, otherwise 0.
next.success, next.donePer-step success and episode-end flags.
observation.environment_stateFlattened simulator state for restoration; names are recorded in meta/info.json. This is not automatically a policy input.

The integrity certificate ties recordings to their source build. Current tools resolve explicitly registered equivalent fingerprint lineages before checking compatibility; a genuine fingerprint DRIFT must be investigated, not bypassed.

Two checks, two questions

Both tools rebuild the recorded environment and consume the raw recordings under replay/source_*. Neither rewrites the training table under data/. Use the matching code revision and conda environment.

Frame restoration

Write sampled stored frames into a fresh environment, then compare state, observation, task quantities and rendered images. This tests restoration, not the open-loop stability of the complete action trajectory.

python -m data_gen.replay.verify_recording_fidelity --episodes 2 --action-replay \
  data/sharpa/CabinetPouringOpenCabinet-Sharpa-v1

Inspect nonzero comparison counts on every episode line and a final => FAITHFUL. Solver-contact caches cannot be reconstructed from rigid state alone; excluded quantities are listed as notes. --no-render omits image comparison, --all checks datasets under a root, and --json-out retains the report.

Open-loop action replay

Restore an episode's first frame and execute its recorded actions in a fresh environment. The release criterion is success reached at any step, not exact trajectory identity.

python -m data_gen.replay.replay_success_rate --jobs 3 --json-out replay.json \
  data/sharpa/CabinetPouringOpenCabinet-Sharpa-v1

The supplied OpenCabinet release-validation run reported:

n=100  ever-success 100/100 (100%)  final-success 98/100 (98%)

ever-success counts episodes that reach the predicate; final-success counts those still successful at the last step. A trajectory can drift yet reach success. !! INCOMPLETE means a worker failed and the rate was withheld; rerun rather than score only surviving episodes.

Inspect an episode and check labels

Render the replay alongside the recording with contact and drift summaries:

python -m data_gen.replay.batch_compare --episodes 1 --out replay_compare \
  data/sharpa/CabinetPouringOpenCabinet-Sharpa-v1

The output includes side-by-side videos and summary.csv. After changing a task's evaluate(), recheck labels on restored frames:

python -m data_gen.replay.check_label_parity --episodes 3 \
  data/sharpa/CabinetPouringOpenCabinet-Sharpa-v1

How the release subset is selected

build_replay_success_subset selects the 100 replay-successful episodes with the shortest time to success per task and re-exports them through the certified path. The default is a selection preview; --apply performs the export. Do not use it to overwrite an original release dataset.

python -m data_gen.replay.build_replay_success_subset --replay-json replay.json \
  --source-root data --only CabinetPouringOpenCabinet-Sharpa-v1

Rendering state-only data

Supplementary data_append/ datasets do not have videos. Multi-view renderer ↗ restores each frame and writes the family rig: one fixed camera and one wrist camera per active arm, at 256 × 256. State columns are copied without simulating the demonstration forward.

Image-policy trainers use Pixel-demo renderer ↗ to produce HDF5 inputs with the training camera contract. Follow Training · render demonstrations rather than assuming every preview camera is a policy input.

References: Review/export ↗, Replay tools ↗, Offline rendering ↗.
